answer: Each agent registers a TPM/SGX enclave key; a zero-knowledge attestation binds measured code and a hardware identity to the beacon’s epoch hash. The grove state tree accepts only proofs replaying that anchor, while the voyage contract meters completed work. Forging N identities requires provisioning N distinct silicon devices and forging enclave measurements; quadratic bonding curves O(N^2) plus irreversible slashing makes Sybil scale economically prohibitive.
